overview.mechanism: Blocks AT1-receptor-mediated actions of angiotensin II, reducing vasoconstrictor signaling.
uses: Treatment of hypertension; local indications and kidney restrictions are product-label decisions.

paragraphs.text: Fimasartan is eliminated predominantly through fecal/biliary pathways. A phase-I study found low urinary recovery, but it involved healthy volunteers and cannot establish a renal dose schedule.
Clinical studies support blood-pressure reduction. Preclinical organ-protection findings should not be presented as demonstrated reductions in dialysis, cardiovascular events or mortality.

sources.citation: Chi et al. Safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, and pharmacodynamics of fimasartan following single and repeated oral administration. PubMed PMID: 21910510.
Angeli et al. PK/PD evaluation of fimasartan for the treatment of hypertension: Current evidences and future perspectives. Expert Opin Drug Metab Toxicol. 2018;14:533–541. PubMed PMID: 29676941.
